essence:
The tṛtīyo vimarśa established the pramāṇa, its fruit, and the primacy of the
knower.

A supreme (pārameśvara) work must be accomplished [by the aspirant]; even if impossible in itself, it
is assumed as possible.

Here the capacity of all the dīkṣā-and-the-rest is stated: even in this birth, the attainment of the
param-Lord — although vision and knowledge are primary, the knowledge is preceded by the dīkṣā.
